introduction: When twenty-year-old Claire finds out she's pregnant, she knows she wants to have an abortion. With confidence in her choice, the support of her family, and good healthcare, everything should be straightforward - she can even take the abortion medication in the comfort of her own home. But the night before the appointment, disturbing hallucinations begin to shake her resolve. At the gynecologist's office, what should be a routine medical experience unfolds as a waking nightmare with lasting repercussions.
